channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Pulse Check On Canadian NHL Teams: Has There Been Any Improvement?
item.description: Most Canadian NHL teams are struggling to keep the puck out of their net, and only two of them are in a playoff position. Gary Pearson digs into the numbers for BetMGM.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Latest On Flames' Kadri, Rangers' Trocheck, Panthers' Bobrovsky And Other Trade Candidates
item.description: New York Rangers center Vincent Trocheck clarifies his modified no-trade list, a reunion between Calgary Flames center Nazem Kadri and the Colorado Avalanche is unlikely, and Sergei Bobrovsky is in no hurry to leave the Florida Panthers.

item.title: Five Things The Maple Leafs Can Do Between Now And The End Of The Season
item.description: Play with pride. Give Easton Cowan some notable ice time. Call up some Marlies. The Maple Leafs still have a lot they can do and accomplish without even thinking about the playoffs.

item.title: NHL Jack Adams Award Rankings: Can Penguins' Dan Muse Beat Avalanche's Jared Bednar?
item.description: Colorado Avalanche coach Jared Bednar has led our NHL Jack Adams Award rankings for most of the season. But Pittsburgh Penguins bench boss Dan Muse leads the top challengers.

item.title: Buffalo Sabres Could Go All-In By Trading For Blues' Robert Thomas, Insiders Say
item.description: The Buffalo Sabres are expected to be big players in the NHL trade market, and talks between them and the St. Louis Blues' Robert Thomas have heated up, according to TSN's Darren Dreger.

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline Central 2026: Trade Tracker, Analysis, Lists And More
item.description: One of the most anticipated weeks on the hockey calendar is here with the 2026 NHL trade deadline on Friday. We're tracking the trades as they happen with analysis, lists and more.

item.title: The Wraparound: Should NHL Teams Be Cautious About Trading For Rentals?
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Adam Kierszenblat discuss the Oilers acquiring Connor Murphy, lands spots for the Rangers' Vincent Trocheck, Matthew Schaefer's ceiling and much more.

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline: Should The Sharks, Predators And Kings Buy Or Sell?
item.description: The San Jose Sharks, Nashville Predators and Los Angeles Kings are the West's top three teams out of a playoff spot. But while being trade deadline buyers could be tempting, only one of them should do so.

item.title: NHL's Top Four Goalie Trade Candidates Ahead Of Deadline
item.description: Let's take a look at a few goalies who have the chance to be moved ahead of the 2026 NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Historic Toronto Hockey Rink Rightfully Saved From Demolition
item.description: A Toronto-area rink was slated for demolition this year, prompting the hockey community – including retired NHL star Eric Lindros – to speak out in defense of the historic arena. On Monday, hockey fans were the winners.
